subject.title: fix(android): keep composer media with its chat

question: Should Android upgrades intentionally migrate the cache to schema version 8 and park legacy rows whose original agent owner cannot be proven, requiring manual re-entry or deletion?
rationale: The implementation is coherent and prevents cross-chat replay, but repository policy reserves SQLite version advances and user-visible fallback removal for explicit human acceptance.

options.title: Accept fail-closed migration
options.body: Approve schema version 8 and the manual-recovery behavior because replaying ownerless rows could target the wrong chat or agent.

options.title: Narrow the first landing
options.body: Land transient composer ownership while deferring persisted cache and outbox ownership to a separately reviewed migration.

options.title: Redesign legacy recovery
options.body: Require a different explicit owner-selection or export flow before migrating legacy outbox rows.

recommendation.title: Accept fail-closed migration
recommendation.body: Approve schema version 8 and the manual-recovery behavior because replaying ownerless rows could target the wrong chat or agent.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored and maintained the durable owner-scoped expansion and are best positioned to confirm the intended Android upgrade contract.
